character_types: neighbor in bathrobe with a pistol
visual_synopsis: A small ring-tailed lemur escapes and runs down a stone-walled village street while a TV bulletin shows two men in numbered prison stripes; one of them, wearing an olive coat over the striped uniform, gets into an apartment and ties up a bespectacled man and his wife on the couch, where most of the sketch plays out in close-up. It ends in another apartment where a man in a red bathrobe pulls a pistol and grapples with the intruder as the animal scampers across the floor.
